title: Applying AI Mind Mapping to Empower Patients with Schizophrenia
content: Schizophrenia affects patients’ organizational thinking ability to identify problems. The main objective of this purposive sampling survey study is to explore healthcare consultants’ application of AI mind maps to educate patients with schizophrenia in their perceptions of family function, social support, quality of life, and loneliness, and to help these patients think more organizationally and understand problems more effectively.
